prompt.generated_prompt_string: First-person perspective. An adult woman is tying her shoelaces when she suddenly looks up at the camera with a surprised friendly expression and says, "Wow, you look familiar—are you a star?" She extends both hands in a welcoming gesture, then lowers them without touching the camera. The camera moves back as she stands, takes a mobile phone from a small sock or leg pouch, and asks whether she may exchange contact information. The camera politely shakes its head and turns away, ending the encounter respectfully. Keep the interaction consensual, non-romantic, and free of kissing or simulated physical contact.
prompt.negative_prompt: non-consensual kiss, simulated touch, romantic coercion, minor, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, blurry, watermark, text, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
